snippet.title: Introducing MindsEye - Explainer | 2025
snippet.description:
Steam Pre-Order: https://go.mindseye.game/steam
PlayStation Pre-Order: https://go.mindseye.game/playstation 
Xbox Pre-Order: https://go.mindseye.game/xbox
Launching June 10, 2025 on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC.

Introducing MindsEye - three seamlessly interconnected experiences: an explosive action-adventure campaign; Play.MindsEye, a continuous stream of premium studio-developed content; and Build.MindsEye to craft your own games.

Launching June 10, 2025, on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC. Pre-order now and get the Deluxe Edition Upgrade with exclusive in-game content.
